title: yamaa 1.0 spec file
description: One file of the 1.0 spec type. A specification file may be one layer of an inheritance chain: the header is required in every layer, a root field it writes is complete there, and inside a member of input, windows, intermediates, columns or rows, and inside output or submission, requiredness waits for the composed specification, which $defs/root_class checks (LAYER-4). Each field carries its kind as x-yamaa-kind and its schema-notation type as x-yamaa-type. Generated from yaml/ by tools/packaging/generate_json_schema.py.

group_by.description: Grouping keys of an ordinary right-side or output-row reduction; omit when the enclosing grouped row owns the keys (LOOKUP-19).

derivations.description: Per-record intermediate variables, by the name the reducer expression reads, evaluated in order before reduction (LOOKUP-22).

order_by.description: Terms ordering the records whose values STR_JOIN joins, over the relation's fields and the derivations' variables, ties keeping stored order; required beside STR_JOIN and refused beside any other expression (FORMULA-18, LOOKUP-10).

separator.description: Text STR_JOIN writes between two joined values, the empty string included; required beside STR_JOIN and refused beside any other expression (FORMULA-18).

distinct.description: When true, STR_JOIN writes each text once and COUNT(x) counts each value once; omitted, every value counts. Admitted only beside a bare STR_JOIN(x) or COUNT(x) (FORMULA-18).

quantile.description: Probability from 0 through 1 at which QUANTILE reads its quantile, R's default type 7; required beside QUANTILE and refused beside any other expression (FORMULA-18).

expr.description: Closed reducer expression over the records of one relation (FORMULA-17).

aggregate_expression.description: Expression in the closed expression grammar that admits the reducers (FORMULA-27).

when.description: Condition that selects this branch when true (EXPR-7).

then.description: Result returned when the condition is true (EXPR-7).

case_item_class.description: A when/then branch, or the trailing otherwise item (EXPR-7).

otherwise.description: Result used when no branch condition is true (EXPR-7).
